description: Synergy reference resolution - understand user references like 'N4', 'C2.1', 'D1'

tools.name: synergy_resolve_reference
tools.description: Resolve a user reference like 'N4' or 'C2.1' to actual Synergy session item. Use this when user says 'continue N4', 'start C2.1', 'check D1', etc.

reference.description: The reference code (N4, C2.1, D1, etc.). Format: N# for next steps, C# for checklist, C#.# for sub-items, D# for documents

session_id.description: Optional session ID. If not provided, uses the most recent active session

returns.description: Resolved item with full context including description, completion status, and session info

when_to_use: User mentions a reference like 'N4', 'C2', 'C2.1', or 'D1'
User says 'continue N4' or 'start working on C2.1'
User asks 'what is N4?' or 'show me D1'
User wants to work on a specific task by its ID
Need to understand what a reference refers to before taking action
prerequisites: A Synergy session must exist with next steps, checklist, or documents
References are assigned automatically by the UI when items are created
C = Checklist (C1, C2... or C1.1, C1.2... for sub-items)
expected_workflow: Result shows: 'Process MGR Roofing - 100 Corflute signs order'
Now you know what N4 is and can take action
Proceed with the task (create invoice, send email, etc.)
error_handling: If reference not found → List all available references with synergy_list_all_references
If no active session → Ask user which session or create new one
If invalid format → Explain valid formats (N#, C#, C#.#, D#)

tools.name: synergy_list_all_references
tools.description: List all available references in a Synergy session (N1-N7, C1-C2, D1, etc.). Use this to show the user what IDs are available.

session_id.description: Optional session ID. If not provided, uses the most recent active session

include_completed.description: Include completed items in the list (default: false)

returns.description: Categorized list of all references with their descriptions and completion status

when_to_use: User asks 'what can I work on?' or 'show me the tasks'
User mentions invalid reference → Show valid ones
User says 'list next steps' or 'show checklist'
Before resolving a reference, to verify it exists
To provide context about what's in the session
expected_workflow: User says 'what tasks do I have?'
Show formatted list: N1-N7 (Next Steps), C1-C2 (Checklist), D1 (Documents)
User can then say 'start N4' and you'll know what it is
presentation: Format output as organized list by type
Show reference IDs clearly (N1, N2, C1.1, etc.)

tools.name: synergy_update_by_reference
tools.description: Update a Synergy item using its reference (N4, C2.1, etc.). Mark as complete, update description, or delete.

reference.description: The reference code (N4, C2.1, D1, etc.)

session_id.description: Optional session ID. If not provided, uses the most recent active session

new_description.description: New description text (required only when action='update')

returns.description: Confirmation of update with the modified item

when_to_use: User says 'mark N4 as complete' or 'done with N4'
User completes a task and mentions its reference
User wants to modify or remove an item
After completing work on a referenced task
prerequisites: Reference must exist in the session
Use synergy_resolve_reference first to verify reference exists
expected_workflow: Confirm to user: 'Marked N4 as complete: Process MGR Roofing order'
best_practices: Always resolve reference first to show user what you're updating
Confirm action before marking as complete (unless user explicitly said 'done')
For updates, show old vs new description
After update, consider suggesting next available tasks
